hashConvention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 LF source files and exact Pester It AST extent. Data-driven selectors are reviewed as groups.

selectors.selector: renders the guard before any apply line, and the script parses
selectors.reviewScope: The generated script is syntactically valid and expiry checks precede both example action types.

selectors.selector: classifies the route plan window as <Expected>
selectors.reviewScope: Evaluates declared windows against a fixed clock. No network or system settings are used.

selectors.selector: refuses a saved apply script whose validity has elapsed before any network command runs
selectors.reviewScope: Invokes the rendered guard with an expired window and an inert command sentinel.

selectors.selector: applies only for Drift with a current plan, guards matching, elevated, and enabled
selectors.reviewScope: Confirms fresh Drift can be admitted and missing window refuses once other conditions hold.

selectors.selector: reports <Expected> drift without rendering or applying the stale plan
selectors.reviewScope: Exercises real watcher flow with mocked adapters and process runner. Invalid plans retain local comparison and publish no actionable script.
